visual_description: A full-width, horizontally-oriented image banner with a pink background, cream-colored typewriter font, and heart icons. The text reads 'ORDER BY 2/10 WITH STANDARD DELIVERY' and 'ORDER BY 2/11 WITH EXPRESS DELIVERY', separated by hand-drawn hearts. The image stretches across the email, clearly dividing headline content from the product/hero section.
purpose: To convey important shipping deadlines with visual emphasis, help create urgency, and act as a visual divider between core sections of the email. The clickable image also provides a quick-link to the store.
rag_text: Order by 2/10 with standard delivery. Order by 2/11 with express delivery. Pink banner with heart icons, used to announce important order deadlines and create urgency before Valentine's Day, visually dividing the email content.
